en_title: 'I’ve Been In a Lot of Harry Potter Already' — Daniel Radcliffe Isn't Sure If He'll Watch HBO's Harry Potter TV Series
cn_title: 「我已经出演了很多《哈利·波特》」——丹尼尔·雷德克里夫不确定自己是否会观看HBO的《哈利·波特》电视剧
opus_summary: 丹尼尔·雷德克里夫接受美联社采访时表示，不确定是否会观看HBO版《哈利·波特》，称自己亲身经历了十多年，也不常看电视。他曾给新版哈利扮演者Dominic McLaughlin写信，但不打算给对方表演建议。该剧首季将于下个月圣诞节开播，第二季已在筹备中。

paragraphs.en: Former Harry Potter actor Daniel Radcliffe isn't sure if he's going to watch HBO's TV adaptation of the Wizarding World.
paragraphs.cn: 曾饰演哈利·波特的演员丹尼尔·雷德克里夫不确定自己是否会观看HBO根据Wizarding World改编的电视剧。

paragraphs.en: When speaking with The Associated Press, Radcliffe was asked whether or not he plans to watch HBO's TV series. He gave an honest answer, admitting that he isn't sure if he will. He noted that, of course, he lived the experience himself for over a decade, but also doesn't actually watch much TV himself.
paragraphs.cn: 雷德克里夫在接受美联社采访时，被问及是否计划观看HBO的这部电视剧。他给出了坦诚的回答，承认自己不确定是否会看。他指出，当然，他自己亲身经历了这一切长达十多年，但他实际上也不怎么看电视。

paragraphs.en: “I haven’t seen Breaking Bad . I haven’t seen Mad Men . I haven’t seen some of the, like, the real classics. So, you know, eight hours is a lot of anything to watch.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我没看过《绝命毒师》。我没看过《广告狂人》。我没看过一些，比如说，真正的经典作品。所以，你知道，不管看什么，看八个小时都算很久了。」

paragraphs.en: "He doesn't need any advice from me": Daniel Radcliffe held back on advising Dominic McLaughlin on his portrayal of Harry Potter in the upcoming TV series. Radcliffe voices the prince in the new animated film "Steps."
paragraphs.cn: 「他不需要我给任何建议」：丹尼尔·雷德克里夫没有就Dominic McLaughlin在即将推出的电视剧中饰演哈利·波特一事向他提建议。雷德克里夫在动画新片《Steps》中为王子配音。

paragraphs.en: Radcliffe's career is obviously partially defined by Harry Potter. However, he has been very aware that the franchise was bound to be remade and was even quoted back in 2012 about the possibility of such a thing. He was a bit dismissive of the idea at the time, noting he wasn't totally fond of remakes, saying they make unnecessary changes for the sake of doing something different.
paragraphs.cn: 雷德克里夫的演艺生涯显然在一定程度上以《哈利·波特》为标志。不过，他一直非常清楚，这个系列注定会被翻拍，早在2012年就曾就这种可能性发表过看法。他当时对这个想法有些不以为然，指出自己并不太喜欢翻拍作品，称它们为了做出不同的东西而进行不必要的改动。

paragraphs.en: Despite this, Radcliffe has been welcoming to the new Potter cast, and even wrote a letter to Dominic McLaughlin , who is playing Harry in the HBO show. He has asked, however, that the press don't badger the new cast about following in the footsteps of the films. Radcliffe told Associated Press he's not interested in giving advice to McLaughlin, as he doesn't want to "haunt" him and has full trust in him as an actor.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管如此，雷德克里夫对新一批《哈利·波特》演员表示欢迎，甚至还给在HBO剧集中饰演哈利的Dominic McLaughlin写了一封信。不过，他也请求媒体不要就接续电影作品一事纠缠新演员们。雷德克里夫告诉美联社，他不打算给McLaughlin提建议，因为他不想「萦绕」在对方身边，而且作为演员，他完全信任McLaughlin。

paragraphs.en: The first season will premiere on HBO next month on Christmas Day, but a second season is already in the works . The plan is to adapt each book into a season of TV, not unlike the films, meaning Season 2 will adapt The Chamber of Secrets. However, the benefit of a show is that you can spend more time with the material and don't have to cut certain things for time. We'll see if HBO sticks the landing on this, but it sounds like Radcliffe may not be actively watching from the sidelines.
paragraphs.cn: 第一季将于下个月的圣诞节在HBO首播，但第二季已经在筹备中。计划是将每本书改编成一季电视剧，与电影的做法相似，这意味着第二季将改编《哈利·波特与密室》。不过，剧集的好处是可以花更多时间呈现素材，不必为了时长而删减某些内容。我们拭目以待HBO能否把这件事做好，但听起来雷德克里夫可能不会在一旁积极关注。
